subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should `stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks` expose `{ preserveCodeRegions: true }` as a public plugin SDK opt-in in this bugfix?
rationale: The code defect is addressed in the shared repair/sanitizer layer, but publishing a new SDK mode is a lasting compatibility-sensitive API choice.

options.title: Accept additive SDK opt-in
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers are comfortable supporting code-region preservation as an explicit plugin SDK mode while the default remains strict.

options.title: Keep code-awareness internal
options.body: Ask for a focused revision that removes `StripPlainTextToolCallOptions` from the public helper and keeps code-aware behavior only in internal delivery paths.

options.title: Split SDK ergonomics
options.body: Land the leak repair without the public option and track the SDK helper mode as a separate API design item.

recommendation.title: Accept additive SDK opt-in
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers are comfortable supporting code-region preservation as an explicit plugin SDK mode while the default remains strict.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main owner signal for the shared repair and SDK helper surface.
